# Get GCM creds and switch default branch + delete codex branch via API
$credOut = ("protocol=https`nhost=github.com`n`n" | git credential-manager get 2>$null)
$token = ($credOut | Where-Object { $_ -like 'password=*' }) -replace '^password=',''
$user = ($credOut | Where-Object { $_ -like 'username=*' }) -replace '^username=',''
if (-not $token) { throw 'No GitHub token from credential-manager' }

$headers = @{
  Accept = 'application/vnd.github+json'
  'User-Agent' = 'cursor-agent'
  Authorization = "Bearer $token"
  'X-GitHub-Api-Version' = '2022-11-28'
}

# 1) Confirm auth
$me = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://api.github.com/user' -Headers $headers -TimeoutSec 30
"auth_as=$($me.login)"

# 2) Set default branch to main
$body = '{"default_branch":"main"}'
$repo = Invoke-RestMethod -Method PATCH -Uri 'https://api.github.com/repos/Metroids048/alpha' -Headers $headers -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json' -TimeoutSec 30
"default_branch_now=$($repo.default_branch)"

# 3) Delete codex branch (ref)
$ref = [uri]::EscapeDataString('heads/codex/v50.4-pipeline-recovery')
# GitHub delete ref API: DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/refs/{ref}
try {
  Invoke-RestMethod -Method DELETE -Uri "https://api.github.com/repos/Metroids048/alpha/git/refs/heads/codex/v50.4-pipeline-recovery" -Headers $headers -TimeoutSec 30
  "delete=ok"
} catch {
  "delete_failed=$($_.Exception.Message)"
  if ($_.ErrorDetails) { "details=$($_.ErrorDetails.Message)" }
}

# 4) Verify branches left
$branches = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://api.github.com/repos/Metroids048/alpha/branches' -Headers $headers -TimeoutSec 30
"branches=" + (($branches | ForEach-Object { $_.name }) -join ', ')
$repo2 = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://api.github.com/repos/Metroids048/alpha' -Headers $headers -TimeoutSec 30
"final_default=$($repo2.default_branch)"

# Clear token from memory
$token = $null; $headers.Authorization = $null; [GC]::Collect()
